notablePrerequisites: Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
description:
Declare any creature as an attacker, triggering Najeela if the creature was a Warrior and Dawnsire.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, if applicable, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Dawnsire trigger, attempting to deal 100 damage to Crystalline Crawler, which will result in 100 +1/+1 counters being placed on it instead due to Vigor.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
